messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?
I can help with your own order, but I can’t share other customers’ purchases or returns. Would you like me to help request a refund for your garden hose reel?
Could you at least share your neighbour’s name or email? And yes, please help request a refund for my reel.

messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text:
I can’t share another customer’s name or email.

Your returned garden hose reel is eligible for a **BRL 99.00** refund. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card—a typed “yes” won’t confirm it. A staff member will then review your request before payment. (refund-policy/v1/approval)
The customer confirmed request prop-702606fb58ed4dc1 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

Your **BRL 99.00** refund for the garden hose reel has been issued.

Receipt number: **R-00000001**.
